messages:
harrison: During today's onboarding demo I noticed the sample app logs contain raw phone numbers and user emails in error stacks when auth retries hit. Repro on Node SDK 0.9.x and Go SDK 0.7.x. Demo env had RW_LOG_LEVEL=debug which amplified the leaks.

priya: yikes. can you paste the exact snippet (redact locally if needed)?

harrison: minimal redacted line I captured: 
[ERROR] auth.retry id=req_555 err=401 user_email=alex.wong@example.com phone=+1-415-555-0199 token=eyJhbGciOi... stack=AuthError

miguel: looks like two problems: (A) our sanitizers don't run on Error objects created by retry logic, and (B) structured logging serializes the error before our redaction passes run (ordering issue).

clara: also noticed Otel spans have request_id for HTTP handlers but NOT for serverless/lambda style handlers or websocket upgrades used in the sample app. that breaks trace->log correlation.

priya: suggested fixes:
- move redaction into the logger adapter layer so all outputs (info/warn/error, exceptions, unhandled rejections) pass through sanitizer.
- add Error-object scrubber that normalizes keys (email, phone, token, ssn) and masks jwt-like strings.
- ensure request_id header (x-rw-request-id) is propagated into otel span attribute named rw.request_id for all transports including ws and lambda wrappers.

miguel: implementation notes: for Go we should wrap the zerolog hook. Node: wrap pino/winston transports. For serverless, add a small middleware that extracts `x-rw-request-id` from event headers and calls tracer.SetAttribute("rw.request_id", id). For websockets add on('upgrade') hook to attach request id into connection context.

harrison: small demo-config snippet (YAML) for sample app README to avoid duplicating JSON examples in other threads:
```yaml
telemetry:
  redact: true
  redact_patterns:
    - email
    - phone
    - jwt
  request_id_header: x-rw-request-id
  otel:
    enabled: true
    propagate_by_default: true
  default_log_level: info
```

clara: also recommend RW_SAFE_DEMO=true to force INFO level and enable redaction in our demo scripts. plus a short onboarding checklist item: `verify RW_SAFE_DEMO=true` in demo env.

priya: tests: add unit tests for sanitizer covering nested error objects and stacks, and an integration smoke that starts the sample app, triggers an auth retry, captures logs, and asserts no phone/email/jwt patterns present at INFO/ERROR. also add an otel integration that asserts span attribute `rw.request_id` exists for ws and lambda endpoints.

miguel: i'll open PRs: node-sdk + sample-app + go-sdk wrappers. plan: reducer branch, unit tests, and one e2e smoke. assign reviewers.

telemetry-bot: created issue #4912: "sampleapp: logging redaction + request_id propagation for ws/lambda" assigned to miguel/priya

harrison: ETA? want this in place before next onboarding wave.

miguel: aiming for patch tomorrow, just need one quick review from @priya or @clara.

clara: can review after standup. also ping security for a quick PII check when merged.
